# Security Review — pass1

## Summary
Scoped brownfield security review of the 23 files touched in run `20261104-005757-feature-new-home-unread-notifications-card` (`HomePageUnreadNotifications` homepage card/widget, `NotificationsPage`/`NotificationsTable` row highlighting, `CardExtension` fallback, tests, API reports, and documentation). No security vulnerabilities or hardcoded secrets were introduced. Dynamic query parameter construction in `HomePageUnreadNotifications.tsx` properly encodes `notification.id` with `encodeURIComponent`, and workspace dependency changes only link the internal `@backstage/plugin-home-react` package.

## Findings
| Severity | Category | Location | Issue | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| None | — | — | No security issues found in the touched set. | — |

## Passing checks
- PII handling: n/a — not in the touched set.
- Authn & authz: n/a — not in the touched set (frontend components use authenticated `notificationsApiRef`).
- Audit log integrity: n/a — not in the touched set.
- Secrets & config: No secrets or credentials in touched source files, test fixtures (`HomePageUnreadNotifications.test.tsx`, `extensions.test.tsx`), or documentation/changesets (`docs/notifications/usage.md`, `docs/notifications/usage--old.md`, `plugins/notifications/README.md`, `.changeset/*.md`).
- Surface & headers: n/a for backend middleware — in touched frontend components, `notification.id` is URL-encoded with `encodeURIComponent` (`HomePageUnreadNotifications.tsx:147`) and notification fields are rendered as React text nodes (no unsafe HTML injection).
- Dependency risk: `plugins/notifications/package.json` and `yarn.lock` only add `"@backstage/plugin-home-react": "workspace:^"` (internal workspace package; no new external dependencies).

## Required fixes before sign-off
- None
